children.value: iti uktamanorājyaprakāreṇa vibudhānāṃ nivāsaṃ vaibudhaṃ puraṃ svargam
tāmālokya sa bhārgavo'pi paravaśo'bhavadityanuṣaṅgaḥ pareṇa vānvayaḥ

niśi viyogātparitaḥ kūjitaṃ ruditaṃ yayā sā kāntā cakravākinī niśānte
prātaścakravākenāvalokiteva

lajjālakṣaṇasyāndhakārasya tīkṣṇāṃśau sūryavannivārake timiramaṇḍale
tasminmaṇḍale nandanapradeśe tasya mithunasya strīpuṃsadvandvasyeva
pratiṣṭhāṃ sthairya āgate prāpte satīti pareṇa sahānvayaḥ
bhūteṣu tasyāḥ sakhījaneṣu tasmātpradeśādabhimatāṃ diśaṃ gateṣu satsu

adhaḥkaroti saṃjīvakādāhlādakācca
candrasahasrādapi priyatamapraṇaya evātiśete iti yāvat
